title: Horo Dynamic Cross-Domain Arbitration Policy Specification
description: Deterministic rule matrix governing cross-tradition conflict resolution, intent-based priority dispatching, and edge mutation in the Semantic Property Graph (G_sem).

core_principles.intent_driven_primacy: The user's query intent dictates the authoritative hierarchy among tradition domains.
core_principles.hard_veto_immunity: Hard Exclusion filters (ZeJi / FengShui) cannot be overridden by higher intent priorities.
core_principles.monotonic_supersession: When a higher-priority domain resolves a conflict, a supersedes edge is created with temporal/priority monotonicity.
core_principles.audit_trail_preservation: All arbitrated claims retain their original conflict declarations in G_sem for audit traceability.

STRATEGIC_TIMING_ACTION.description: Selecting optimal timing or directional execution for business launch, negotiations, investments, or travel.

NATAL_CHARACTER_PATH.description: Analyzing foundational life structure, innate temperament, psychological archetype, and long-term destiny path.

priority_hierarchy.role: Root Five Elements & Day Master Anchor

SPATIAL_LOCATION_OFFICE.description: Evaluating residence/office energy, Qi flow, sector orientation, and directional auspiciousness.

TACTICAL_DIVINATION_EVENT.description: Discrete situational forecast, binary query resolution, lost object recovery, or immediate crisis response.

HEALTH_VITALITY.description: Assessing constitution, organ vulnerabilities, energetic imbalances, and seasonal health risks.

arbitration_rules.name: Intent Priority Dominance
arbitration_rules.description: When Domain A has higher intent rank than Domain B (rank_A < rank_B), Claim A supersedes or qualifies Claim B.
actions: Reduce effective weight of Claim_B by factor: (rank_B - rank_A) * 0.25
Set edge status of contradicts to 'resolved_by_priority'

arbitration_rules.name: Equal Rank Materiality & Confidence Tiebreaker
arbitration_rules.description: When conflicting claims originate from domains of identical rank, compute composite score S = materiality * (0.4 * calc_integrity + 0.3 * source_support + 0.3 * rule_match).
actions: If |S_A - S_B| >= 0.20: Winning claim qualifies losing claim; create [:qualifies] edge.
If |S_A - S_B| < 0.20 AND severity >= 0.70: Maintain active contradiction and trigger FSM_H3_HITL_ESCALATION.

arbitration_rules.name: Hard Exclusion Veto Absolute Precedence
arbitration_rules.description: Any claim with claim_type == 'hard_exclusion' and action == 'EXCLUDE_CANDIDATE' immediately eliminates candidate without regard to positive affirmative claims.
actions: Prune affected candidate moment/sector from recommendation list
Emit FSM_H2_EXCLUSION event with canonical citation
Suppress contradictory affirmative claims for this specific candidate

arbitration_rules.name: Echo Chamber / Confirmation Bias Guard
arbitration_rules.description: When cross_agent_agreement > 0.90 but all agreeing agents have source_support < 0.50, flag as ungrounded consensus.
